create_edge_degree_embedding: create an EdgeDegreeEmbedding module with radial MLP and Wigner-D scattering for spherical harmonic edge features
run_edge_degree_forward: run the EdgeDegreeEmbedding forward pass with node features, edge features, edge index, and Wigner inverse envelope
create_chg_spin_embedding: create a ChgSpinEmbedding module using positional, linear, or random embedding for atomic charge or spin values
run_chg_spin_forward: run the ChgSpinEmbedding forward pass to embed charge or spin values into a fixed-size vector
create_dataset_embedding: create a DatasetEmbedding module with per-dataset learnable embeddings and optional gradient freezing for dataset identification
